uad.config:
DATALOADER:
  CAMERA_PRIORITY: false
  NUM_INSTANCE: 4
  NUM_WORKERS: 8
  SAMPLER: PKM
DATASETS:
  DATASET_DIR: WHU-MARS
  FILTER_GD: false
  MODALITIES:
  - RGB
  - IR
  - Thermal
  NAMES: WHU-MARS
  ROOT_DIR: /project/code/data
INPUT:
  PADDING: 10
  PIXEL_MEAN:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PIXEL_STD:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PROB: 0.5
  RE_PROB: 0.5
  SIZE_TEST:
  - 256
  - 128
  SIZE_TRAIN:
  - 256
  - 128
MODEL:
  ATT_DROP_RATE: 0.0
  COS_LAYER: false
  DEVICE: cuda
  DEVICE_ID: '0'
  DEVIDE_LENGTH: 4
  DIST_TRAIN: false
  DROP_OUT: 0.0
  DROP_PATH: 0.1
  GPD_MOMENTUM: 0.2
  ID_LOSS_TYPE: softmax
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
  IF_LABELSMOOTH: 'off'
  IF_WITH_CENTER: 'no'
  JPM: false
  LAST_STRIDE: 1
  METRIC_LOSS_TYPE: wrt
  NAME: transformer
  NECK: bnneck
  NO_MARGIN: true
  PCA_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.01
  PRETRAIN_CHOICE: none
  PRETRAIN_PATH: jx_vit_base_p16_224-80ecf9dd.pth
  RE_ARRANGE: true
  SHIFT_NUM: 5
  SHUFFLE_GROUP: 2
  SIE_CAMERA: false
  SIE_COE: 3.0
  SIE_VIEW: false
  STRIDE_SIZE:
  - 16
  - 16
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: vit_base_in
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
  WRT_STABLE: false
OUTPUT_DIR: ./logs/UAD_1000
SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.008
  BIAS_LR_FACTOR: 2
  CENTER_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.0005
  CENTER_LR: 0.5
  CHECKPOINT_PERIOD: 120
  COSINE_MARGIN: 0.5
  COSINE_SCALE: 30
  EVAL_PERIOD: 10
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  LARGE_FC_LR: false
  LOG_PERIOD: 50
  LOSS_TYPE: base+pca+gpd
  MARGIN: 0.3
  MAX_EPOCHS: 120
  MOMENTUM: 0.9
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: SGD
  SEED: 1234
  STEPS:
  - 40
  - 70
  WARMUP_EPOCHS: 5
  WARMUP_FACTOR: 0.01
  WARMUP_METHOD: linear
  WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.0001
  WEIGHT_DECAY_BIAS: 0.0001
TAUR:
  ADAPTER_LR_FACTOR: 3.0
  BOTTLENECK: 128
  ENABLED: false
  LAYERS:
  - 6
  - 9
  LOG_DIRECTION_GRADS: false
  MARGIN: 0.03
  RAMP_END_EPOCH: 20
  RANK_WEIGHT: 0.1
  RHO: 0.1
  TEMPERATURE: 0.07
  WARMUP_EPOCHS: 5
TEST:
  DETAILED_DOMAIN_EVAL: false
  DIST_MAT: dist_mat.npy
  EVAL: false
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 512
  NECK_FEAT: before
  RE_RANKING: false
  TOP_K_EVAL: 0
  WEIGHT: ''
